spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence uses present continuous for a temporary situation?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] Our neighbour is walking to work this week because of the bus strike.
B. [WRONG] Our neighbour walks to work every day. He says it keeps him fit.
C. [WRONG] Our neighbour walked to work before he bought a car.
D. [WRONG] Our neighbour walks past our house every morning at seven.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: Our neighbour walks to work every day. He says it keeps him fit., Our neighbour walked to work before he bought a car., Our neighbour walks past our house every morning at seven.
